page.overview:
What is Poodle-sized cockroach?

Pudel blattodea, more commonly dubbed the poodle–sized cockroach, was a species of extraterrestrial insect that resembled a cockroach and was comparable in size to a giant poodle.

Poodle–sized cockroaches apparently existed outside of a colonial post; during a celebration of the launch of the Weyland-Yutani Corporation colony ship held on the vessel's bridge in 2104, ship's pilot Maggie Faris mentioned that she knew of the creatures by way of a report.

The bugs were also mentioned during a conversation concerning the differences between the Arcturians and the Arctura that was overheard in a spaceport bar at Coronado Colony as of 2184.
